description:
What this role is about
This is an ownership role, not "keep the lights on" Cloud Operations. You own the client's infrastructure on Google Cloud from design to operations: you shape the architecture, automate everything that can be automated, and keep production running reliably, securely and cost-efficiently.

Inside the client team, your decisions have real impact. At CloudHero, you are part of a small, senior team where learning and sharing knowledge are part of the job.


Key responsibilities

  • Infrastructure on GCP: design, build and operate the client's cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud, working side by side with their engineers, with an emphasis on automation, scalability and low maintenance.
  • Technical delivery: lead delivery within the client team: assessments, migrations, modernization and ongoing operations.
  • Kubernetes: build and manage Kubernetes platforms on GKE, including cluster lifecycle, autoscaling and application deployment with Helm.
  • CI/CD: implement and maintain pipelines following GitOps principles (Argo CD / Flux, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Cloud Build).
  • Infrastructure as Code: write and maintain infrastructure with Terraform; use Ansible or similar tools for configuration management.
  • Observability: ensure strong monitoring, logging and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging).
  • Security: implement security best practices across infrastructure and pipelines: IAM, Workload Identity, image and pipeline scanning, Security Command Center, Organization Policy and Cloud Asset Inventory.
  • Cost: identify cost-optimization opportunities and run reviews based on the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework.
  • Operations: troubleshoot and resolve critical production issues, then drive post-incident improvements.
  • Advisory and mentoring: advise the client team on architecture, scaling and DevOps best practices; mentor other engineers and contribute to CloudHero's internal standards, templates and reusable modules.


Must-have requirements

  • GCP is the main cloud. Equivalent hands-on AWS experience is accepted wherever noted below.
  • 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure roles, with a strong Linux background and hands-on production ownership.
  • Cloud: proven experience designing and running production workloads on GCP (preferred) or AWS.
  • Kubernetes: strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (GKE preferred, EKS accepted) and with Helm.
  • Terraform: solid experience, including writing and maintaining reusable modules.
  • CI/CD: experience building pipelines, ideally with GitOps workflows.
  • Networking: good understanding of VPC design, Shared VPC, DNS, load balancing and proxies such as NGINX or Envoy.
  • Observability: practical experience with monitoring and logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or similar).
  • Security: working knowledge of cloud security best practices and native security services, preferably on GCP (on AWS: Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config).
  • Ownership: able to own a project end to end and make sound technical decisions independently, while collaborating closely with the client's team.
  • Native Romanian and fluent English, spoken and written.


Nice to have

  • Google Cloud Professional certifications (Cloud Architect, Cloud DevOps Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer) or AWS equivalents (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, Security Specialty).
  • Hands-on cost optimization on GCP (Committed Use Discounts, Spot VMs, rightsizing).
  • Exposure to GenAI workloads on Vertex AI (or Amazon Bedrock / SageMaker).
  • Consulting or team augmentation experience, working inside a client's team.


Don't tick every box? If you are strong on the must-haves, apply anyway. The nice-to-haves are things you can grow into, not gates.


Ways of working

  • Works closely with the client's engineers, day to day, as part of their team.
  • Comfortable advising on architecture and explaining designs and trade-offs.
  • Shares knowledge: mentors other engineers and contributes to CloudHero's standards.


What we offer

  • Ownership of a client's Google Cloud infrastructure, from design to operations, with real impact on their team.
  • A small, senior CloudHero team where learning and sharing knowledge are part of the job.
  • Hybrid setup with an office in central Bucharest (Victoriei area).
  • Competitive package, depending on experience and contract type (B2B or employment).
  • Support from CloudHero, a cloud-native consulting and managed services company, and its community of DevOps and platform engineers.


Who is likely to be a strong match

  • Engineers who can clearly explain infrastructure they personally designed, built and operated: a GKE or EKS platform, reusable Terraform modules, a CI/CD or GitOps setup, a monitoring and alerting stack.
  • They can discuss concrete cloud services, production incidents and the trade-offs behind their decisions.


Who is probably not a fit

  • Profiles that have only consumed infrastructure built by a dedicated DevOps or platform team, without building or improving any of it.
  • Mainly support, monitoring or ticket-based operations roles without design ownership.
  • Candidates without hands-on production cloud experience.
